test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mr. Prakash writes short stories.

options.text: Short stories were written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories are being written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories have been written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories are written by Mr. Prakash.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Mr. Prakash writes short stories."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "short stories" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "writes" to "are written" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Mr. Prakash."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Short stories are written by Mr. Prakash."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Short stories were written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"Short stories are being written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Short stories have been written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
